title: C Breeze | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Fun Family Main and Carriage Houses - Private Pool - Room for Everyone - Multiple Family - Extended Family - Great Location - Bike to Alys and Rosemary - Pet Friendly
description_expanded: Description: C Breeze by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 12 C Street, Inlet Beach Details: Welcome to your own slice of 30A in the tranquil heart of Seacrest Beach just west of Alys Beach! C Breeze is the perfect vacation rental for multi generations each looking for something different on their getaway. Boasting a sprawling backyard oasis with a large private pool between the cozy main house, and a fun uniquely designed carriage house, each offering full kitchens. It’s the perfect spot for your family to unwind and bask in the glorious Florida sun. Just a quick stroll away lies the beach, where sugar-white sands and emerald waves are always at your beck and call. Start your day with sandy toes and salty air, and when the sun gets too toasty, retreat to your pool haven or chill out on the shady screened porches. With loads of outdoor space, this home is a dream come true for families seeking casual comfort, privacy, and a whole lot of fun. The carriage house is the perfect hideaway for a family or young adults craving their own retreat. Plus, you're just a hop, skip, and a jump from the charming vibes of Alys and Rosemary Beaches, where delightful shops, tasty eateries, and the lively atmosphere await. With six adult bikes, cruising along Scenic 30A to explore the area is a breeze. If you’re on the hunt for a Seacrest Beach escape with sprawling outdoor space, a private pool, and easy beach access, this is your ticket to an unforgettable 30A adventure! - Private Heated Pool - Carriage House - Short Walk to Private Deeded Beach Access - Large Fenced Pool Between Main and Carriage Houses - Two Full Kitchens - Pet Friendly - 6 Adult Bikes - Fireplace for Cool Evenings - Short Bike Ride to Alys and Rosemary Beaches - 5 Parking Spaces - Multiple Porches * Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). * The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. * Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Beds / 5 Full Baths First Floor Main: Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) Additional Sleeping: Sleeper Sofa -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room / Laundry Second Floor Main: Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower), Screened Porch Guest Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) Lower Carriage: Guest Bedroom 4: King Bed with Shared Full Bath (Shower) Additional Sleeping: Sleeper Sofa Kitchen / Living / Outdoor Dining Upper Carriage: Guest Bedroom 5: Queen Bed with Private Bath Screened Outdoor Seating If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
